praesentātĭo , ōnis, f. praesento,
I.a placing before, a showing, representation, exhibition (post-class.): “tironis,” Cod. Just. 12, 28, 2 (al. praestatio): “adhuc in comminatione est (judicium), nondum in praesentatione,” Aug. in Psa. 59, 6 ; id. Mir. S. Steph. 2, 5, 1.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
